name: hero-digital-success

frames.best_why: Everything is in place: headline, both buttons, the pitch and the frosted service grid.

tagline: Blue light sweeps behind a huge headline that fades in on scroll.
summary: A full-screen dark hero with a moving blue gradient wash, a split-colour headline, two pill buttons, a short pitch and a frosted grid of service labels.
appearance: A black full-screen section under a wide drifting ribbon of blue. A top bar holds three small white links and a dark pill with a red dot. Below, a huge headline reads Unlocking in white over Digital Success in red, with two pale pill buttons and a short paragraph.
behaviour: Each block fades and rises into place in sequence as the section scrolls into view: logo, nav, headline, buttons, paragraph, then the service panel. The blue gradient drifts on its own the whole time.
demo_content: Web agency copy: 'Unlocking Digital Success', Book a Consultation and More about us, plus four service labels.
search_phrases: full screen hero with animated blue gradient
agency landing page above the fold
huge headline with two tone colour
book a call button in the nav
dark hero with pill buttons and services
site header over a shader backdrop
use_when: A digital agency landing page needs an immediate statement with a moving blue backdrop.
avoid_when: Runs a WebGL shader every frame at full viewport; fifty colours are hardcoded.
customise: Headline, paragraph, links and service labels are written into the JSX; shader colours and camera values are inline props on the backdrop.
weight_why: A full-viewport WebGL gradient shader animates nonstop behind the content.

a11y.note: No reduced-motion handling, so the shader keeps moving; the logo is an unlabelled SVG and the button image has empty alt.

issues: The animated gradient ignores prefers-reduced-motion entirely.
The logo mark is an unlabelled SVG, not a link home.
Service labels are 12px grey on frosted glass and read poorly at this size.
polish_why: Bold full-bleed gradient and confident type; tiny service text and no motion opt-out are the gaps.
